Passenger · Israel

Passengers of flydubai Flight 1073

flydubai Flight 10732026Developing story
Flight
flydubai Flight 1073
Date
30 September 2026
Aircraft
Boeing 737 MAX 8
Location
Tabuk, Saudi Arabia

This is a recent event and an investigation is under way. Details may change as more is confirmed.

When the wounded captain, Smit Machchhar, managed to open the cockpit door of flydubai Flight 1073, passengers rushed in. Tali Manes had raised the alarm after hearing the struggle while waiting outside the front toilet for her daughter. Her husband Tzvika Manes, Yaniv Hayun, Asaf Rajuan and Dr Shota Musayev got into the cockpit and overpowered the first officer, and Musayev treated the captain's wounds, while off-duty flydubai pilots took over and landed the plane at Tabuk. Israel's President Isaac Herzog has recommended the four men for the Presidential Award for Civilian Heroism.

Who helped

  • Smit Machchhar CaptainThough badly wounded, he opened the cockpit door from the inside so passengers and an off-duty pilot could get in.Sources: 1 2 3 4 5
  • Tali Manes PassengerWaiting outside the front toilet for her 6-year-old daughter, she heard the struggle in the cockpit and raised the alarm.Sources: 1 2 3 4 5
  • Tzvika Manes PassengerRushed from the front row, got into the cockpit and helped overpower the attacker, tying him up with headphone cables.Sources: 1 2 3 4 5
  • Yaniv Hayun PassengerGot into the cockpit, helped pull the attacker away from the controls, then pulled back on the controls to help level the plane until a pilot took over.Sources: 1 2 3 4
  • Asaf Rajuan PassengerGot into the cockpit and helped overpower the attacker.Sources: 1 2 3 4
  • Dr Shota Musayev Passenger (dentist)Helped tie up the attacker, then treated the badly wounded captain, stopping his bleeding.Sources: 1 2 3 4
  • Two off-duty flydubai pilots Off-duty crewTravelling as passengers to fly the return leg, they took over the controls and landed the plane safely at Tabuk. They have not been officially named.Sources: 1 2 3 4 5
  • David Kimotho Lead flight attendant (purser)With John Muchina, gave the wounded captain first aid on the cabin floor and kept order, telling passengers to sit down.Sources: 1 2 3 4
  • John Muchina Cabin crewGave the wounded captain first aid alongside Kimotho, checking that he was conscious and helping keep the cabin calm.Sources: 1 2 3 4
